title: Mountain View, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Mountain View, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Mountain View is a city in CA with a population of 82,000. Google’s global headquarters with a vibrant tech scene and downtown revitalization. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
